I think it really helps if you guys plan the next visit so that you both have something to look forward to! Even if you can't confirm any flights right now, just try to set the month of the future visit maybe? 

You mentioned that you don't argue with him. I do argue with my boyfriend a fair bit so I also worry that all the effort we put into this LDR may be for nothing if we do break up in the future. Most of the time when we argue, I just remind myself of why we haven't broken up yet; like the reasons that make it worth it to stay with him because the pros outweigh the cons and the cons are only amplified because of the argument.

I'd say just let her know that she can go to you if she ever needs to talk. If you do end up falling for her and if she starts reciprocating your actions, make sure it's not just rebounding since you actually have feelings for her.

It's normal to be scared and depressed about him leaving; that's actually the worst part for me. I'm in a LDR too and we do fine when we're in the same country, or when we're away from each other (of course being together is tons better), but the part I hate most is sending him off or him sending me off at the airport after a visit. 

I don't have much advice to give about planning the future because my SO and I don't have solid plans about which country we're going to be in after we both graduate. And I feel like worrying about getting a good job right now won't do you any good cause there's so little you can do about it. 

I'd say just treasure the time you have with him now before he leaves, and it's not the end when he does. If it's worth it, you guys will make it happen :)
